name: Jamf
summary: Jamf manages Apple devices. Jamf for Mac costs $12.50 per device a month and Jamf for Mobile costs $5.75, both billed annually with a 25-device minimum. Jamf Now, for organizations under 25 employees, starts at $4 per device a month. Jamf lists SOC 2 and ISO 27001 on its trust center.

facts.text: Jamf Pro enrolls mobile devices three ways: Automated Device Enrollment for organization-owned devices, Device Enrollment for manual enrollment, and User Enrollment for personally owned devices, which requires Managed Apple IDs.
Configuration profiles are .mobileconfig files that define settings and restrictions for devices, computers and users.
The Wipe Device command permanently erases all data on a mobile device and deactivates it, while the device record stays in Jamf Pro.
Lock Device can show an optional message and phone number on the lock screen of a mobile device.
Jamf's pricing page says local-currency pricing is available through a Jamf representative or a reseller and may differ from the USD figures.
